Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates patchy, ill-defined opacities in the right lower lung zone (right basal shadowing), which is characteristic of bronchopneumonia. In patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, impaired cough and secretion clearance predispose them to aspiration and lower respiratory tract infections, making this finding the most likely cause of his dyspnea and non-productive cough.
